title: Media Outreach and Health Communication
description:
My work goes beyond traditional lectures; I have conducted video sessions on Vyas TV, reaching over a hundred higher education institutes simultaneously. Additionally, I coordinated a Health Communication module for the Tata Memorial Centre in Mumbai and contributed to the CPN Indonesia program. This program involved lectures by me and invited guest faculty, aligning with the expertise of Prof. (Dr.) Sunetra Sen Narayan, Head of Health Communication at IIMC.

I continue as Coordinator of the Health Communication module for Tata Memorial Centre’s Master’s in Patient Navigation in Oncology – the Kevat program – teaching its students to communicate with patients and to counter health misinformation.

title: Recognition and Global Engagements
description: I was awarded the Best Professor Teaching Advertising Management by ABP National B-School Awards in 2013, and my work extends globally. I have been an invited speaker at esteemed institutions like Jamia Milia Islamia, OP Jindal Global University, and Pennsylvania State University. My speaking engagements cover diverse topics, from advertising to new media.

title: Leadership in Education at IIMC (2008-09)
description: In the academic year 2008-09, I took on the role of Program Director for the Advertising & Public Relations Department at the Indian Institute of Mass Communication (IIMC), New Delhi. Overseeing a diverse group of 60+ students, I conceptualized and managed the year-long Post-Graduate Diploma in Advertising & Public Relations. This encompassed syllabus creation, class organization, teaching, grading, and involvement in other PG Diploma programs and short-training courses, including the unique Development Journalism Program catering to media professionals from various countries.
